headline: Today in cardiometabolic health: AHA 2026: Insights on Oral PCSK9, Survodutide, and HF Care Come to Chicago

REPATHA® LOWERS RISK OF HEART ATTACKS BY 20% COMPARED WITH EZETIMIBE IN A LARGE REAL-WORLD STUDY
